minimal_reuse.files_needed: One private worker shim plus a small serial controller/result reducer; observer can reuse the already audited E04 packet observer
minimal_reuse.entry: The shim imports the frozen tool worker module with source/tool/model_benchmark on sys.path, installs process-local wrappers, then calls worker.main() with the unchanged per-job JSON contract.
minimal_reuse.job_contract: worker.main requires config/model/mode/round/directory/info. info must contain the current Engine SHA, static input_shape and original Ultralytics metadata. Alias model names can select R0_before/candidate/R0_after, all resolving to the identical Engine path.
minimal_reuse.controller: Reuse benchmark.load_config/run_worker/Progress/Records and reporting.metrics. To dispatch a shim without editing the tool, after loading config point the isolated imported benchmark.HERE at a private directory containing worker.py=the shim. Keep the same machine-wide /tmp/soccer_model_benchmark_<uid>.lock and inherited fd, serial process groups, telemetry and own-group cleanup.
minimal_reuse.factory_hook: Before worker.system_run(), replace node.PipelineFactory locally with a subclass of the original. Its create() calls super(), wraps that pipeline.detector.load and close, then returns it. worker.system_run later subclasses this wrapper, so its timing loop remains unchanged.
load_order: CandidateFactory.load calls saved real detector.load() once. Existing load initializes predictor with one raw dummy, installs A2+Graph, executes one optimized dummy and synchronizes.
Record actual runtime identity and the A2-owned model.predict binding; assert existing mode a2_graph and preprocess c0.
Install only candidate predictor.preprocess hook (R0 uses unchanged preprocessing plus identical instrumentation). Do not install_pipeline again or recapture another Graph.
Return to worker load wrapper, which sets its imgsz/rect predict wrapper. All candidate preprocessing is now installed before the worker 100 real stereo-frame warmups.
minimal_reuse.warm_boundary: Wrap Progress.set in this process. At forced measurement start (stage=测量, completed=0, elapsed=0) save one warm hook/observer snapshot after 100 completed published warm cycles; do not alter the worker begin/done logic. Candidate and baseline receive identical observation overhead.
minimal_reuse.frame_records: Subclass worker.Records only for system fields; augment each row from cached numeric payload observation and optional last preprocess method wall, then call the original add(row, metric) exactly once. Keep original sample/timing keys unchanged.
minimal_reuse.payload_observer: Wrap node.build_ball_position_camera_payload(packet), call original once and return that exact payload object. Cache only numeric metrics derived from packet/payload; no mutation, GPU tensor readback, per-frame file IO or added synchronization.
close_order: Save final existing optimization_status(), candidate describe() and observer counters before restoring/clearing the model.

Verify the current model.predict is precisely the worker forced-shape outer wrapper and its old_predict closure points to the binding saved after real load; restore that saved binding before original detector.close(). Cache observed wrapper identity and reject unexpected replacement instead of overwriting another owner.

candidate.restore() restores original predictor.preprocess; then saved detector.close() restores A2+Graph and releases model. Failed ownership/restore must fail the job, retain evidence and stop later jobs.
Write restore status and restore all process-local class/function patches in finally; never leave altered module objects for another same-process job.

necessary_interfaces.detail: Runs actual installed node/pipeline with per-process class wrappers; no loop copy needed.
Outer CandidateFactory can wrap detector.load/close; actual hardware/model open occurs later in node.run_ros_node.
Candidate hook belongs after saved load returns, before first detector call and 100 warm frames.
Forced shape wrapper masks the A2-owned predict identity; must undo it before A2.restore.
detector_ms times detect_candidates_batch only; backend binding verification happens afterwards inside pipeline wall.
Completes a row only after publishing and visualization; counts 100 warm frames then measures until >=60s.
Keeps parent-death protection, Engine SHA check, signals and complete/interrupted/failed result markers.
Packet observation before scheduler.wait/publish; measurement_valid differs from tracked payload valid.
Both output paths must retain publish_end. They count output cycles, not a guaranteed PointStamped for every invalid frame.

extra_numeric_csv.frame_timestamp_s: float(packet.timestamp); relative source timestamp, not SDK exposure time
extra_numeric_csv.preprocess_method_ms: optional perf_counter wall wrapper around predictor.preprocess; no CUDA synchronize, includes enqueue/wait effects and is already inside detector wall

statistics.publish_hz: (N-1) / (last.publish_end - first.publish_end); actual publisher-call output cycles, not subscriber reception or per-topic delivery
statistics.latency: mean/P50/P95/P99 separately for detector_ms, cycle_ms, read_ready_to_publish_ms; P99 must be recomputed from raw CSV because reporting.stats currently omits it
statistics.scope: read_ready_to_publish excludes SDK capture/buffering and downstream delivery; cycle includes scheduling wait, ROS and visualization; no GPU/CPU wall summation
statistics.validity: measurement_valid/N, tracking_valid/N, both-eye nonempty, selected pair valid and candidate count distributions per job; tracking/coasting is not current-frame measurement validity
statistics.pairing: 3 complete blocks, each R0_before -> candidate -> R0_after. Per-block reference=(R0_before metric+R0_after metric)/2; average 3 block effects equally, not per-frame pseudo-replicates.
statistics.pooling: Pooled raw percentiles descriptive only. Hz uses sum of each worker active intervals, never gaps between separate worker monotonic timestamps.
statistics.posthoc: If validity/count mixture differs, report whole-frame primary results plus exact-one-per-eye & measurement_valid latency-only sensitivity; never compute filtered-subset Hz or call validity ratios physical precision.

hook_acceptance.startup_offsets: Existing production load contributes one optimized dummy before candidate install. Graph/A2 warm absolute calls can therefore be101, candidate preprocess100; do not hardcode every component warm==100.
must_hold: No Graph/A2/candidate fallback_count increase and no last_error/cleanup_error
current frames update Graph input and ordinary output ownership stays intact
same Engine hash, runtime shape,dtype,thresholds,NMS/top-k across jobs
A2 D2H is actual nonempty batches, bytes=24*packed_rows; do not require48B for arbitrary live candidate counts
all restore operations complete and worker result complete; incomplete block excluded, retries do not silently reuse partial groups

gaps_and_traps: benchmark default config contains E01 and E02 and Viser=true, while frozen deployed detector config already a2_graph and visualization=false; do not execute that default config.
benchmark.run_worker sets ROS_DOMAIN_ID but not ROS_LOCALHOST_ONLY. Set both explicitly before importing/initializing rclpy; launch only this perception worker, never運控 or the normal control launch.
Current worker predict wrapper must be unwound before A2 restore; otherwise a successful timing window can end as failed cleanup.
Current CSV has no packet validity/candidate counts, preprocessing wall, Graph counters or warm checkpoint; packet diagnostics exist in memory but are not recorded.
reporting.stats provides P50/P95 only. Its standard comparison uses label-level pooled R0, not 3 bracket paired blocks; use a private CSV reducer as primary comparison.

source/config cannot prove current hardware MAXN or GPU clocks. Record read-only nvpmodel/clock/temperature/background telemetry per job; do not compare this R0 with prior25W E04 Hz as a like-for-like result.

At high MAXN processing capacity a50Hz publish cap can mask detector improvement; preserve production50Hz for this system test and record scheduler wait if diagnosing saturation, rather than changing the primary contract.

Actual output cycle Hz is available; subscriber reception, per-topic delivered Hz, SDK exposure-to-publish age, GPU-only preprocessing event times and queue age are not available from this worker. Do not label host timestamps as those metrics.

go_no_go.before_system: First correctness on allowed frozen Val inputs, changing-input freshness, exact letterbox/color/normalize and Graph output ownership. Then screen actual detector saving.
go_no_go.stop: Best credible saving<1ms: stop with negative result, no system benchmark required.
go_no_go.if_admitted: User-run long script, serial9 timed60s jobs plus100 warm/frame per job, no concurrent GPU work; wrappers same overhead in R0/candidate; preserve all logs/config/SHA/raw rows.
go_no_go.this_review: No source edits, robot access, GPU tests, dependency installations or experiment launch were performed.
